title: 1 defendant takes plea deal in In-Shape kidnapping, rape case - NewsBreak
text:
By Jason Kotowski ,
9 hours ago
BAKERSFIELD, Calif. (KGET) — One of two men accused of kidnapping a woman outside a fitness center on Coffee Road has taken a plea deal.
Jesus Chavez Torres pleaded no contest this week to kidnapping and vehicle theft-related charges in the abduction of a woman from In-Shape Family Fitness on Coffee Road.
He faces 18 years in prison and is set for sentencing May 7.
Co-defendant Vincent DeLeon allegedly forced the woman to withdraw money from an ATM and raped her. His trial is scheduled to begin this month.
DeLeon admitted to kidnapping and robbing her, but claimed they had consensual sex, police said.
Both DeLeon and Torres are gang members.
The woman told police she arrived at the gym around 7 a.m. on Dec. 15, 2023, and returned to her car about 45 minutes later.
After she sat down, a man opened the door, pointed a gun at her head and told her to get in the passenger seat, she said according to police.
He drove to an ATM and made her withdraw money, she said, then took her to an orchard near Taft where he raped her.
After being dropped at the Vallarta Supermarket on Panama Lane, the woman ran inside and got help.
DeLeon was arrested the same day after leading police on a chase in the stolen car. The woman identified him as her kidnapper and rapist.
It’s alleged Torres was with DeLeon in the parking lot before the abduction and met him after the woman was released to buy clothing using her stolen credit cards. He told police they went to In-Shape in DeLeon’s girlfriend’s car to “pop windows” — burglarize vehicles.
